h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Georgia? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options for 2026
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Georgia? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico para 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of employer coverage to enroll through Georgia Access. Georgia did not expand Medicaid, so most laid-off Georgia workers rely on the Georgia Access Marketplace SEP rather than Medicaid.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse en Georgia Access. Georgia no expandio Medicaid, por lo que la mayoria de trabajadores despedidos dependen del SEP del Mercado Georgia Access.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your Georgia employer coverage ends. For example, if your last day of coverage is June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through August 29, 2026. Miss that window and you typically wait until the next Georgia Access Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. Georgia Pathways to Coverage (limited Medicaid for qualifying adults up to 100% FPL with work requirements) has no SEP deadline and accepts applications year-round, but requires 80 qualifying hours per month to maintain.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura de su empleador en Georgia. Por ejemplo, si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, tipicamente espera hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta de Georgia Access que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de 2027. Georgia Pathways to Coverage acepta solicitudes todo el ano, pero requiere 80 horas calificadas al mes para mantener la cobertura.

label.en: Georgia Pathways to Coverage (if income under 100% FPL + work hours met)
label.es: Georgia Pathways to Coverage (si ingresos bajo 100% FPL + horas de trabajo cumplidas)
PeachCare for Kids (para ninos, todo el ano)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based health insurance in Georgia triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Because Georgia has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, most laid-off Georgia adults cannot rely on Medicaid and must use the Georgia Access Marketplace at GeorgiaAccess.gov to enroll in an ACA plan with income-based subsidies, typically $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits in 2026. Three limited Medicaid options exist: (1) Georgia Pathways to Coverage for adults 19 to 64 under 100% FPL ($15,960/year single) who meet 80 qualifying work or activity hours per month; (2) PeachCare for Kids for children under 19 in families up to 247% FPL ($81,510/year for a family of 4), which is Georgia's CHIP program; and (3) COBRA at 102% of the full premium, often $500 to $2,800 per month. Georgia workers earning between 0% and 100% FPL who cannot meet Pathways' work requirements face a coverage gap where Georgia Access Marketplace Bronze plans are the most affordable fallback.
quickAnswer.es: Perder el seguro medico del trabajo en Georgia activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias. Debido a que Georgia no expandio Medicaid bajo el ACA, la mayoria de adultos georgianos despedidos no pueden depender de Medicaid y deben usar el Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov para inscribirse en un plan ACA con subsidios basados en ingresos, tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales en 2026. Existen tres opciones limitadas de Medicaid: (1) Georgia Pathways to Coverage para adultos de 19 a 64 anos bajo el 100% FPL ($15,960/ano individual) que cumplan 80 horas calificadas de trabajo o actividad al mes; (2) PeachCare for Kids para ninos menores de 19 en familias hasta el 247% FPL; y (3) COBRA al 102% de la prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,800 al mes.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in Georgia is stressful enough. Losing your health insurance at the same time is harder in Georgia than in most states, because Georgia has not expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. In the 40 expansion states plus DC, laid-off workers can often move straight into free Medicaid if their income drops below 138% FPL. Georgia offers only a limited alternative: Georgia Pathways to Coverage, which serves adults ages 19 to 64 under 100% FPL ($15,960 per year for a single person in 2026) but requires documenting at least 80 hours per month of work, job training, education, or qualifying community service. Workers who were just laid off and cannot yet document those hours are left in a coverage gap. For those Georgians, the Georgia Access Marketplace at GeorgiaAccess.gov is the primary path to affordable coverage. Under federal HIPAA Section 9831 rules, any involuntary loss of minimum essential employer-sponsored coverage is a qualifying life event (QLE) that opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. That 60-day SEP window is the same whether you were laid off, furloughed, or your Georgia employer closed. The 2026 Georgia Access Open Enrollment Period ended January 15, 2026. Without a SEP triggered by your job loss, you have no path to subsidized coverage until the 2027 OEP opens November 1, 2026. Acting within 60 days is not optional.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Georgia es suficientemente estresante. Perder su seguro medico al mismo tiempo es mas dificil en Georgia que en la mayoria de estados, porque Georgia no expandio Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. En los 40 estados de expansion mas DC, los trabajadores despedidos a menudo pueden pasar directamente a Medicaid gratuito si sus ingresos caen por debajo del 138% FPL. Georgia ofrece solo una alternativa limitada: Georgia Pathways to Coverage, que sirve a adultos de 19 a 64 anos bajo el 100% FPL ($15,960 al ano para una persona en 2026) pero requiere documentar al menos 80 horas al mes de trabajo, entrenamiento laboral, educacion o servicio comunitario calificado. Bajo las reglas federales de la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA, cualquier perdida involuntaria de cobertura minima esencial es un evento calificador de vida (QLE) que abre un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias en el Mercado Georgia Access de GeorgiaAccess.gov.

introParagraphs.en: Georgia Access is Georgia's own state-based Marketplace exchange that replaced healthcare.gov for Georgia residents starting with plan year 2025. Georgia workers who lose job coverage must apply at GeorgiaAccess.gov, not healthcare.gov, to access ACA Marketplace plans with premium tax credits. The 60-day SEP clock starts the day after your employer coverage ends, which for most Georgia employer plans is the last day of the month in which you were terminated. Your projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) determines the size of your premium tax credit. Because the enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act and the Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026, the 400% FPL subsidy cliff has returned for plan year 2026. Households with projected 2026 income above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four) receive no premium tax credit. Most people who lose a job, however, also see their income drop sharply, which frequently moves them well below the 400% FPL cliff and makes large premium tax credits newly available. Children's coverage is handled separately through PeachCare for Kids, Georgia's CHIP program, which is available year-round to children under 19 in families earning up to 247% FPL, with low or no premiums.
introParagraphs.es: Georgia Access es el Mercado basado en el estado de Georgia que reemplazo a healthcare.gov para los residentes de Georgia a partir del ano del plan 2025. Los trabajadores georgianos que pierden la cobertura del trabajo deben aplicar en GeorgiaAccess.gov, no en healthcare.gov, para acceder a los planes del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima. El reloj SEP de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura de su empleador. Su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026 determina el tamano de su credito fiscal de prima. Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano y la Ley de Reduccion de Inflacion expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que el precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL ha regresado para el ano del plan 2026. La cobertura de los ninos se maneja por separado a traves de PeachCare for Kids, el programa CHIP de Georgia, disponible todo el ano para ninos menores de 19 en familias que ganan hasta el 247% FPL.

name.en: Confirm your last day of Georgia employer coverage
name.es: Confirme su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador en Georgia

text.en: Call your HR department or check your Georgia termination letter to get the exact date employer coverage ends. Most Georgia employer plans end on the last day of the month you were terminated, but some end on the actual termination date. This date starts your 60-day SEP clock. Request a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage in writing from your former employer's HR department. You will need it as proof of the qualifying life event when you submit your Georgia Access SEP application at GeorgiaAccess.gov.
text.es: Llame a su departamento de recursos humanos o revise su carta de terminacion de Georgia para obtener la fecha exacta en que termina la cobertura del empleador. La mayoria de planes del empleador en Georgia terminan el ultimo dia del mes en que fue despedido. Esta fecha inicia su reloj SEP de 60 dias. Solicite un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA por escrito a su antiguo empleador. Lo necesitara como prueba del evento calificador de vida cuando envie su solicitud SEP en GeorgiaAccess.gov.

name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026

text.en: Use only what you expect to earn for the rest of 2026, not your previous annual salary. Include any unemployment compensation you receive from the Georgia Department of Labor, because unemployment benefits count as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) under IRS rules. If your projected 2026 income falls under 100% FPL ($15,960 single, $33,000 family of 4) and you can document 80 qualifying activity hours per month, check Georgia Pathways to Coverage at pathways.georgia.gov. If your projected income is between 100% and 400% FPL, apply for a Georgia Access Marketplace plan with premium tax credits at GeorgiaAccess.gov.
text.es: Use solo lo que espera ganar el resto de 2026, no su salario anual anterior. Incluya cualquier compensacion por desempleo que reciba del Departamento de Trabajo de Georgia, porque los beneficios de desempleo cuentan como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) bajo las reglas del IRS. Si su ingreso proyectado para 2026 cae bajo el 100% FPL ($15,960 individual, $33,000 familia de 4) y puede documentar 80 horas de actividad calificada al mes, verifique Georgia Pathways to Coverage en pathways.georgia.gov. Si su ingreso proyectado esta entre 100% y 400% FPL, solicite un plan del Mercado Georgia Access con creditos fiscales en GeorgiaAccess.gov.

name.en: Check Georgia Pathways to Coverage if income is under 100% FPL
name.es: Verifique Georgia Pathways to Coverage si sus ingresos estan bajo el 100% FPL

text.en: Georgia Pathways to Coverage is the only Medicaid program available to non-disabled, non-pregnant adults ages 19 to 64 in Georgia. Eligibility requires projected income under 100% FPL ($15,960 per year for a single person in 2026) plus documentation of 80 qualifying hours per month of employment, job training, education, caregiving for a child under 6, or other approved activities. Apply at the Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov or call 1-877-423-4746. Note that Georgia is one of the 10 non-expansion states: adults between 100% FPL and 138% FPL who do not meet work requirements have no Medicaid option and must use Georgia Access Marketplace plans.
text.es: Georgia Pathways to Coverage es el unico programa de Medicaid disponible para adultos no discapacitados, no embarazadas, de 19 a 64 anos en Georgia. La elegibilidad requiere ingresos proyectados bajo el 100% FPL ($15,960 al ano para una persona en 2026) mas documentacion de 80 horas calificadas al mes de empleo, entrenamiento laboral, educacion, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos, u otras actividades aprobadas. Aplique en el portal Gateway de Georgia en gateway.ga.gov o llame al 1-877-423-4746. Georgia es uno de los 10 estados sin expansion: los adultos entre 100% FPL y 138% FPL que no cumplen los requisitos de trabajo no tienen opcion de Medicaid y deben usar planes del Mercado Georgia Access.

name.en: Apply for a Georgia Access Marketplace SEP at GeorgiaAccess.gov within 60 days
name.es: Solicite un SEP del Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov dentro de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to GeorgiaAccess.gov and report your qualifying life event (loss of job-based coverage). Upload your termination letter or HIPAA certificate as documentation. Compare Silver and Gold plan options for your Georgia ZIP code. In 2026, premium tax credits reduce most Silver plans to $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income applicants with income between 100% and 400% FPL. Georgia Access differs from healthcare.gov: Georgia residents must use GeorgiaAccess.gov or call 888-687-1503. Do not apply at healthcare.gov for 2026 Georgia coverage, as Georgia transitioned to its own state-based Exchange.
text.es: Inicie sesion en GeorgiaAccess.gov e informe su evento calificador de vida (perdida de cobertura del trabajo). Cargue su carta de terminacion o certificado HIPAA como documentacion. Compare opciones de planes Silver y Gold para su codigo postal de Georgia. En 2026, los creditos fiscales de prima reducen la mayoria de planes Silver a $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados con ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL. Georgia Access es diferente de healthcare.gov: los residentes de Georgia deben usar GeorgiaAccess.gov o llamar al 888-687-1503.

name.en: Check whether your spouse's employer plan is an option
name.es: Verifique si el plan del empleador de su conyuge es una opcion

text.en: Your Georgia job loss is also a qualifying life event for your spouse's employer plan, giving you 30 days to enroll. Call your spouse's HR department immediately, because the 30-day employer-plan window is separate from and shorter than the 60-day Georgia Access Marketplace SEP. Your spouse's employer plan is often the cheapest option if the premium is employer-subsidized, but check whether your current Georgia doctors and specialists are in-network before enrolling.
text.es: La perdida de su trabajo en Georgia es tambien un evento calificador de vida para el plan del empleador de su conyuge, dandole 30 dias para inscribirse. Llame inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su conyuge, porque la ventana del plan del empleador de 30 dias es separada y mas corta que el SEP del Mercado Georgia Access de 60 dias. El plan del empleador de su conyuge es a menudo la opcion mas barata si la prima esta subsidiada, pero verifique que sus medicos actuales en Georgia esten dentro de la red antes de inscribirse.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA only after comparing all other options
name.es: Evalue COBRA solo despues de comparar todas las otras opciones

text.en: COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium (your former employer's share plus your share plus a 2% administrative fee). For a single person in Georgia, that is typically $500 to $900 per month; for a family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month in 2026. COBRA is worth considering only if you have ongoing treatment with a Georgia specialist not in any Georgia Access Marketplace network, or if your 2026 deductible is already substantially met and you need to keep the same plan through year-end. You have 60 days to elect COBRA and can elect it retroactively, so you do not have to decide immediately. Compare COBRA cost against Georgia Access Marketplace plans at GeorgiaAccess.gov before deciding.
text.es: COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa (parte de su antiguo empleador mas la suya mas el 2% de tarifa administrativa). Para una persona en Georgia, eso es tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes; para una familia, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes en 2026. COBRA vale la pena considerar solo si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista de Georgia que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado Georgia Access, o si su deducible de 2026 ya esta sustancialmente cumplido. Tiene 60 dias para elegir COBRA y puede elegirlo retroactivamente. Compare el costo de COBRA con los planes del Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov antes de decidir.

name.en: Enroll your children in PeachCare for Kids even if you do not qualify for Pathways
name.es: Inscriba a sus hijos en PeachCare for Kids aunque no califique para Pathways

text.en: PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program, covering children under age 19 in families earning up to 247% FPL (approximately $81,510 per year for a family of four in 2026). PeachCare enrollment is year-round with no 60-day SEP deadline. Even if your income is too high for Georgia Pathways or traditional Medicaid after the job loss, your children may qualify for PeachCare at low or zero cost. Apply through the Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov or through GeorgiaAccess.gov to check PeachCare eligibility simultaneously with your own Georgia Access Marketplace SEP application.
text.es: PeachCare for Kids es el programa CHIP de Georgia, que cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos en familias que ganan hasta el 247% FPL (aproximadamente $81,510 al ano para una familia de cuatro en 2026). La inscripcion en PeachCare es todo el ano sin fecha limite SEP de 60 dias. Incluso si sus ingresos son demasiado altos para Georgia Pathways o Medicaid tradicional despues de la perdida del trabajo, sus hijos pueden calificar para PeachCare a bajo costo o sin costo. Aplique a traves del portal Gateway de Georgia en gateway.ga.gov o a traves de GeorgiaAccess.gov para verificar la elegibilidad de PeachCare junto con su propia solicitud SEP del Mercado Georgia Access.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes Georgia workers make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los trabajadores de Georgia cometen despues de perder cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Going to healthcare.gov instead of GeorgiaAccess.gov. Georgia transitioned to its own state Exchange in 2025. Applying at healthcare.gov will not produce a valid 2026 Georgia plan enrollment. Always use GeorgiaAccess.gov or call 888-687-1503.
items.es: Ir a healthcare.gov en lugar de GeorgiaAccess.gov. Georgia hizo la transicion a su propio intercambio estatal en 2025. Aplicar en healthcare.gov no producira una inscripcion valida en un plan de Georgia 2026. Siempre use GeorgiaAccess.gov o llame al 888-687-1503.

items.en: Assuming Georgia has full Medicaid expansion. Georgia is one of 10 non-expansion states. Most non-disabled, non-parenting Georgia adults who are laid off do not qualify for Medicaid, even at very low incomes, unless they meet Georgia Pathways' 80-hour-per-month activity requirement.
items.es: Asumir que Georgia tiene expansion completa de Medicaid. Georgia es uno de los 10 estados sin expansion. La mayoria de adultos georgianos no discapacitados que son despedidos no califican para Medicaid, incluso con ingresos muy bajos, a menos que cumplan el requisito de actividad de 80 horas al mes de Georgia Pathways.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing Georgia Access Marketplace options. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, often $500 to $2,800 per month. Most income drops from a Georgia job loss generate premium tax credits that make Georgia Access Marketplace Silver plans far cheaper.
items.es: Optar automaticamente por COBRA sin comparar opciones del Mercado Georgia Access. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, a menudo $500 a $2,800 al mes. La mayoria de las caidas de ingresos por perdida de trabajo en Georgia generan creditos fiscales que hacen los planes Silver del Mercado Georgia Access mucho mas baratos.

items.en: Reporting your old Georgia salary instead of projected 2026 income. The Georgia Access Marketplace calculates premium tax credits based on your projected income for the rest of 2026, not the salary you earned before layoff. A lower projection means a larger credit. Include unemployment compensation from Georgia DOL in your projection.
items.es: Reportar su salario anterior en Georgia en lugar del ingreso proyectado de 2026. El Mercado Georgia Access calcula los creditos fiscales de prima basado en su ingreso proyectado para el resto de 2026, no el salario que ganaba antes del despido. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo del DOL de Georgia en su proyeccion.

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. Without active SEP documentation, GeorgiaAccess.gov will reject a Marketplace application submitted after Day 60. The next path is waiting for the 2027 OEP starting November 1, 2026, creating a gap in coverage.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP de 60 dias. Sin documentacion SEP activa, GeorgiaAccess.gov rechazara una solicitud del Mercado enviada despues del dia 60. El siguiente camino es esperar la OEP 2027 que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026, creando una brecha en cobertura.

items.en: Forgetting to enroll children in PeachCare for Kids separately. PeachCare for Kids covers Georgia children under 19 in families up to 247% FPL year-round, with premiums as low as $0 to $35 per month. Even if you must pay for your own Georgia Access plan, your children may qualify for PeachCare at little to no cost.
items.es: Olvidar inscribir a los ninos en PeachCare for Kids por separado. PeachCare for Kids cubre a ninos georgianos menores de 19 en familias hasta el 247% FPL todo el ano, con primas tan bajas como $0 a $35 al mes. Incluso si debe pagar por su propio plan Georgia Access, sus hijos pueden calificar para PeachCare a poco o ningun costo.

heading.en: COBRA vs Georgia Access Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan: Which Should You Choose in 2026?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado Georgia Access vs Plan del Conyuge: Que Debe Elegir en 2026?

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Georgia in 2026, three major pathways open. COBRA preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage, making it the most expensive option in almost every scenario. Georgia Access Marketplace plans (applied at GeorgiaAccess.gov, not healthcare.gov) drop most enrollees to $10 to $300 per month after premium tax credits in 2026, per KFF Marketplace Premium Analysis, with the trade-off that you may need to change providers if your former employer's plan network differs from available Georgia Access plans. A spouse's employer plan costs the employee share of the group premium, often $100 to $600 per month, and is available within a 30-day qualifying-event window under Section 9831 of HIPAA. The decision framework specific to Georgia is: check Georgia Pathways to Coverage first only if projected income is under 100% FPL and you can meet the 80-hour monthly activity requirement (free, year-round); then check your spouse's plan (if cheaper than Georgia Access and network is acceptable); then apply for a Georgia Access Marketplace SEP with premium tax credits (the most common 2026 path for laid-off Georgia workers with income between 100% and 400% FPL); use COBRA only as a last resort when you have ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any Georgia Access network, or have a substantially met 2026 deductible to preserve.
body.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Georgia en 2026, tres caminos principales se abren. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar, convirtiendolo en la opcion mas cara en casi todos los escenarios. Los planes del Mercado Georgia Access (aplicados en GeorgiaAccess.gov, no en healthcare.gov) reducen a la mayoria de los inscritos a $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima en 2026. El plan del empleador de un conyuge cuesta la parte del empleado de la prima grupal, a menudo $100 a $600 al mes, y esta disponible dentro de una ventana de evento calificador de 30 dias bajo la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA. El marco de decision especifico para Georgia es: verificar Georgia Pathways primero solo si el ingreso proyectado esta bajo el 100% FPL y puede cumplir el requisito de actividad mensual de 80 horas; luego verificar el plan del conyuge; luego solicitar un SEP del Mercado Georgia Access con creditos fiscales; usar COBRA solo como ultimo recurso.

stateRules.rule: Georgia has NOT adopted full ACA Medicaid expansion. The only Medicaid program for non-disabled, non-pregnant adults 19 to 64 is Georgia Pathways to Coverage, available to those under 100% FPL ($15,960 single, 2026) who document 80 qualifying hours per month of work, education, job training, caregiving for a child under 6, or approved community service. Apply at gateway.ga.gov or call 1-877-423-4746.

Georgia uses Georgia Access (GeorgiaAccess.gov) as its own state-based Marketplace Exchange, separate from healthcare.gov. Georgia residents enrolling in 2026 ACA Marketplace plans must apply at GeorgiaAccess.gov or call 888-687-1503. The federal healthcare.gov portal does not process Georgia 2026 plan enrollments.

PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program covering children under 19 in families up to 247% FPL (approximately $81,510 for a family of four in 2026). Premiums range from $0 to $35 per month. Apply at gateway.ga.gov or georgiaaccess.gov. Enrollment is year-round.

Georgia's coverage gap affects adults with income between 0% and 100% FPL who do not meet Georgia Pathways work requirements, and adults between 100% and 138% FPL. Approximately 359,000 Georgians fall in this gap. ACA Marketplace Silver and Bronze plans at GeorgiaAccess.gov are available for those above 100% FPL; those below 100% FPL without Pathways eligibility have limited options.

heading.en: Georgia's Medicaid Situation After Job Loss: Pathways, Coverage Gap, and PeachCare in 2026
heading.es: La Situacion de Medicaid en Georgia Despues de Perder el Trabajo: Pathways, Brecha de Cobertura y PeachCare en 2026

paragraphs.en: Georgia stands apart from 40 other states and DC because it has not adopted full Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act. In expansion states, any adult whose projected income falls under 138% FPL ($22,025 for a single person in 2026) qualifies for Medicaid immediately after job loss, free of charge, year-round. Georgia Pathways to Coverage, the state's limited alternative, covers adults ages 19 to 64 only up to 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person in 2026) and requires documenting at least 80 hours per month of employment, job training, approved education, caregiving for a child under age 6, or other qualifying activities. Georgia Pathways is the nation's only ongoing work-requirement Medicaid program as of 2026. Workers who were just terminated and cannot immediately document qualifying hours still face a gap in Medicaid access even at very low incomes. Most laid-off Georgia adults who qualify for Pathways already had jobs (by definition), so the program's eligibility is narrower in practice than the income threshold suggests.
paragraphs.es: Georgia se distingue de otros 40 estados y DC porque no ha adoptado la expansion completa de Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. En los estados de expansion, cualquier adulto cuyo ingreso proyectado cae bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona en 2026) califica para Medicaid inmediatamente despues de perder el trabajo, de forma gratuita, todo el ano. Georgia Pathways to Coverage, la alternativa limitada del estado, cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos solo hasta el 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona en 2026) y requiere documentar al menos 80 horas al mes de empleo, entrenamiento laboral, educacion aprobada, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos, u otras actividades calificadas. Georgia Pathways es el unico programa de Medicaid con requisito de trabajo en curso de la nacion a partir de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Georgia's coverage gap falls into two layers. First, adults with income between 0% and 100% FPL who cannot meet Pathways' 80-hour monthly activity requirement have no Medicaid option. Second, adults between 100% FPL and 138% FPL have too much income for Pathways but too little for Marketplace plans to be affordable without subsidy. Georgia Access Marketplace plans at GeorgiaAccess.gov are available for both groups if income exceeds 100% FPL, where premium tax credits kick in. For those below 100% FPL without Pathways eligibility, free-standing community health centers operating under HRSA Section 330 (Federally Qualified Health Centers, or FQHCs) provide sliding-scale care that may serve as a bridge during the coverage gap. The Georgia Medicaid agency recommends applying at gateway.ga.gov and checking simultaneously for Pathways eligibility, PeachCare for Kids for children, and Georgia Access Marketplace eligibility.
paragraphs.es: La brecha de cobertura de Georgia cae en dos capas. Primero, los adultos con ingresos entre 0% y 100% FPL que no pueden cumplir el requisito de actividad mensual de 80 horas de Pathways no tienen opcion de Medicaid. Segundo, los adultos entre 100% FPL y 138% FPL tienen demasiado ingreso para Pathways pero muy poco para que los planes del Mercado sean asequibles sin subsidio. Los planes del Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov estan disponibles para ambos grupos si el ingreso supera el 100% FPL, donde entran en vigor los creditos fiscales de prima. Para aquellos debajo del 100% FPL sin elegibilidad de Pathways, los centros de salud comunitarios que operan bajo la Seccion 330 de HRSA (Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente, o FQHC) proporcionan atencion a escala deslizante.

heading.en: COBRA vs Georgia Access Marketplace: The 2026 Georgia-Specific Decision Framework
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado Georgia Access: El Marco de Decision Especifico de Georgia para 2026

paragraphs.en: After losing job-based coverage in Georgia in 2026, COBRA and Georgia Access Marketplace plans are the two most common options for adults who do not qualify for Georgia Pathways. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, meaning you pay both the employer and employee share plus a 2% administrative fee. For Georgia employees, typical COBRA costs in 2026 run $500 to $900 per month for single coverage and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage, depending on your former plan. COBRA is available for 18 months for most job-loss qualifying events under the federal COBRA statute (for Georgia employers with 20 or more employees; smaller employers are not covered by federal COBRA).
paragraphs.es: Despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en Georgia en 2026, COBRA y los planes del Mercado Georgia Access son las dos opciones mas comunes para adultos que no califican para Georgia Pathways. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, lo que significa que paga tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%. Para los empleados de Georgia, los costos tipicos de COBRA en 2026 van de $500 a $900 al mes para cobertura individual y de $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar, dependiendo de su plan anterior. COBRA esta disponible por 18 meses para la mayoria de eventos de perdida de trabajo (para empleadores de Georgia con 20 o mas empleados).

paragraphs.en: Georgia Access Marketplace Silver plans at GeorgiaAccess.gov typically cost $10 to $300 per month after 2026 premium tax credits for applicants with income between 100% and 400% FPL, a fraction of COBRA cost. Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSR) are available only to households between 100% and 250% FPL, reducing deductibles, copays, and out-of-pocket maximums significantly. The 2026 ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family. CSR plans at Silver level can reduce the individual maximum to as low as $3,000 for households under 150% FPL. Apply at GeorgiaAccess.gov and call 888-687-1503 for Georgia-certified assister support at no cost. COBRA makes sense for Georgia workers only when ongoing treatment with a specialist who is not in any Georgia Access Marketplace network is the primary consideration, or when a 2026 deductible is already substantially met and switching plans would reset it.
paragraphs.es: Los planes Silver del Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima de 2026 para solicitantes con ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL, una fraccion del costo de COBRA. Los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) estan disponibles solo para hogares entre 100% y 250% FPL, reduciendo deducibles, copagos y maximos de gasto de bolsillo significativamente. El maximo de gasto de bolsillo del Mercado ACA 2026 es $10,600 para un individuo y $21,200 para una familia. Los planes CSR a nivel Silver pueden reducir el maximo individual a tan bajos como $3,000 para hogares bajo el 150% FPL. Aplique en GeorgiaAccess.gov y llame al 888-687-1503 para soporte de asistente certificado por Georgia sin costo.

heading.en: Documents and the Georgia Access SEP Application Process in 2026
heading.es: Documentos y el Proceso de Solicitud SEP de Georgia Access en 2026

paragraphs.en: The Georgia Access SEP application at GeorgiaAccess.gov for loss of coverage requires specific documentation to validate the qualifying life event. Your Georgia employer termination letter serves as primary proof, showing the exact date coverage ends. A COBRA election notice from your former employer also confirms the qualifying event date and is accepted by GeorgiaAccess.gov. A HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage, which your employer must provide under Section 9831 after coverage loss, details the type and dates of prior coverage. Request all three documents in writing from your former employer's HR department before starting the Georgia Access application. Georgia Access accepts uploaded PDFs or images of these documents.
paragraphs.es: La solicitud SEP de Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov por perdida de cobertura requiere documentacion especifica para validar el evento calificador de vida. Su carta de terminacion del empleador de Georgia sirve como prueba principal, mostrando la fecha exacta en que termina la cobertura. Un aviso de eleccion COBRA de su antiguo empleador tambien confirma la fecha del evento calificador y es aceptado por GeorgiaAccess.gov. Un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA, que su empleador debe proporcionar bajo la Seccion 9831 despues de la perdida de cobertura, detalla el tipo y las fechas de cobertura anterior. Solicite los tres documentos por escrito al departamento de recursos humanos de su antiguo empleador antes de iniciar la solicitud de Georgia Access.

paragraphs.en: Income documentation for the Georgia Access premium tax credit calculation follows IRS Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) rules. Pay stubs from your final weeks of Georgia employment help establish your prior income. Your Georgia Department of Labor unemployment benefit award letter establishes your weekly benefit amount, which counts as income for ACA subsidy purposes. Project your total 2026 income when you apply; if that projection later proves materially wrong, you reconcile at tax time using Form 1095-A and IRS Schedule PTC. Underestimating income leads to a tax-time repayment of excess advance premium tax credits; overestimating leads to a tax refund. Accurate income projection on the Georgia Access application is the single most important step in getting the right subsidy amount from the start.
paragraphs.es: La documentacion de ingresos para el calculo del credito fiscal de prima de Georgia Access sigue las reglas del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) del IRS. Los talones de pago de sus ultimas semanas de empleo en Georgia ayudan a establecer sus ingresos anteriores. Su carta de beneficio de desempleo del Departamento de Trabajo de Georgia establece su monto de beneficio semanal, que cuenta como ingreso para propositos de subsidio ACA. Proyecte sus ingresos totales de 2026 cuando solicite; si esa proyeccion mas tarde resulta materialmente incorrecta, la reconcilia en el tiempo de impuestos usando el Formulario 1095-A y el Anexo PTC del IRS. La proyeccion precisa de ingresos en la solicitud de Georgia Access es el paso mas importante para obtener el monto correcto de subsidio desde el principio.

heading.en: PeachCare for Kids: Georgia CHIP Coverage After a Parent's Job Loss in 2026
heading.es: PeachCare for Kids: Cobertura CHIP de Georgia Despues de la Perdida del Trabajo de un Padre en 2026

paragraphs.en: PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program providing health, dental, and vision coverage for children under 19 in families with income up to 247% FPL (approximately $81,510 per year for a family of four in 2026). PeachCare is separate from adult Medicaid and Georgia Pathways: children can be covered by PeachCare even when their parents do not qualify for any Medicaid program. Enrollment is year-round with no SEP deadline. Monthly premiums range from $0 for lower-income families to $35 for families near the 247% FPL ceiling. Georgia's PeachCare is one of the more generous CHIP programs nationally, covering pediatric care, well-child visits, immunizations, dental, vision, mental health, and prescription drugs.
paragraphs.es: PeachCare for Kids es el programa CHIP de Georgia que proporciona cobertura de salud, dental y vision para ninos menores de 19 en familias con ingresos hasta el 247% FPL (aproximadamente $81,510 al ano para una familia de cuatro en 2026). PeachCare es separado del Medicaid para adultos y de Georgia Pathways: los ninos pueden estar cubiertos por PeachCare incluso cuando sus padres no califican para ningun programa de Medicaid. La inscripcion es todo el ano sin fecha limite SEP. Las primas mensuales van de $0 para familias de menores ingresos a $35 para familias cerca del techo del 247% FPL. PeachCare de Georgia es uno de los programas CHIP mas generosos a nivel nacional, cubriendo atencion pediatrica, visitas de bienestar infantil, inmunizaciones, dental, vision, salud mental y medicamentos recetados.

paragraphs.en: Apply for PeachCare for Kids through the Georgia Gateway portal at gateway.ga.gov or through GeorgiaAccess.gov, which routes to the Georgia Gateway system for Medicaid and CHIP determination. Applications can also be submitted by calling 1-877-423-4746 or visiting a Department of Family and Children Services (DFCS) office in Georgia. Children can be enrolled in PeachCare independently of the parent's own insurance choice. A parent may enroll in a Georgia Access Marketplace plan while simultaneously enrolling their children in PeachCare, splitting coverage to minimize total family cost. This combination strategy often results in lower total family insurance cost than putting all family members on the same Marketplace plan or on COBRA.
paragraphs.es: Solicite PeachCare for Kids a traves del portal Gateway de Georgia en gateway.ga.gov o a traves de GeorgiaAccess.gov, que dirige al sistema Georgia Gateway para determinacion de Medicaid y CHIP. Las solicitudes tambien pueden enviarse llamando al 1-877-423-4746 o visitando una oficina del Departamento de Servicios Familiares y de Ninos (DFCS) en Georgia. Los ninos pueden inscribirse en PeachCare independientemente de la eleccion de seguro propia del padre. Un padre puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado Georgia Access mientras inscribe simultaneamente a sus hijos en PeachCare, dividiendo la cobertura para minimizar el costo familiar total.

en.question: What is the Special Enrollment Period window after losing a job in Georgia in 2026?
en.answer: Your loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period in Georgia starts the day after your employer health coverage ends and runs for 60 consecutive calendar days. For example, if coverage ends June 30, 2026, your SEP window is July 1 through August 29, 2026. Apply at GeorgiaAccess.gov (not healthcare.gov, which no longer processes Georgia 2026 enrollment) and select your plan before Day 60. Plans typically take effect on the first of the month following enrollment. Georgia Pathways to Coverage and PeachCare for Kids have no deadline and are available year-round if income qualifies.

en.question: Does Georgia have Medicaid expansion? Can I get Medicaid after losing my job in Georgia?
en.answer: Georgia has not adopted full ACA Medicaid expansion as of 2026. The only Medicaid option for non-disabled Georgia adults ages 19 to 64 who are not pregnant is Georgia Pathways to Coverage, available to those with projected income under 100% FPL ($15,960 per year for a single person in 2026) who document 80 qualifying hours per month of work, job training, education, caregiving for a child under 6, or approved activities. Apply at gateway.ga.gov or call 1-877-423-4746. Most laid-off Georgia workers earning between 100% and 400% FPL must use the Georgia Access Marketplace SEP at GeorgiaAccess.gov for subsidized coverage.

en.question: Where do I enroll in a health plan after losing my job in Georgia in 2026?
en.answer: Georgia residents must apply through Georgia Access at GeorgiaAccess.gov, not healthcare.gov. Georgia transitioned to its own state-based Marketplace Exchange starting with plan year 2025. Log in to GeorgiaAccess.gov, report your qualifying life event (loss of job coverage), upload your termination letter or HIPAA certificate, and compare available Silver, Gold, and Bronze plans for your Georgia ZIP code. For free help, call the Georgia Access contact center at 888-687-1503 or find a Georgia-certified insurance agent or navigator at GeorgiaAccess.gov.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove job loss for the Georgia Access SEP application?
en.answer: GeorgiaAccess.gov accepts your Georgia employer termination letter, a COBRA election notice, or a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage as documentation of the qualifying life event. The document must show the exact date your employer coverage ends. Upload the document when you start your SEP application at GeorgiaAccess.gov. If you do not yet have the document, you can begin the application and upload it later, but your 60-day SEP window continues running. Contact your former Georgia employer's HR department immediately to request the termination letter and HIPAA certificate in writing.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing a job in Georgia in 2026?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best financial choice for laid-off Georgia workers. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, meaning you pay both the employer and employee share plus a 2% fee. For a single Georgia employee, that typically runs $500 to $900 per month in 2026. For a family, COBRA often reaches $1,200 to $2,800 per month. Georgia Access Marketplace Silver plans with premium tax credits typically cost $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income applicants at GeorgiaAccess.gov. COBRA makes sense mainly if you have ongoing treatment with a specialist not in any Georgia Access network, or if you have a substantially met 2026 deductible you need to preserve through year-end.

en.question: What is PeachCare for Kids in Georgia, and does my child qualify after I lose my job?
en.answer: PeachCare for Kids is Georgia's CHIP program covering children under 19 in families with income up to 247% FPL, approximately $81,510 per year for a family of four in 2026. Monthly premiums range from $0 to $35. PeachCare enrollment is year-round with no 60-day deadline. Even if your own income disqualifies you from Georgia Pathways to Coverage, your children may qualify for PeachCare at little or no cost. Apply at gateway.ga.gov or georgiaaccess.gov, or call 1-877-423-4746. A parent can enroll in a Georgia Access Marketplace plan while enrolling children in PeachCare simultaneously to minimize total family insurance cost.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP after job loss in Georgia?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day loss-of-coverage SEP means you typically cannot enroll in a subsidized Georgia Access Marketplace plan until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15, 2027, creating a potential coverage gap. Georgia Pathways to Coverage and PeachCare for Kids remain open year-round regardless of the SEP window. If another qualifying life event occurs during the gap (moving within Georgia to a new county with different plan availability, getting married, having a baby), that event restarts a new 60-day SEP at GeorgiaAccess.gov. Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in Georgia offer sliding-scale primary care for uninsured Georgians during any coverage gap.

en.question: Does unemployment income count toward Georgia Access subsidy eligibility in 2026?
en.answer: Yes. Georgia Department of Labor unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) calculations at GeorgiaAccess.gov. Include your weekly unemployment benefit multiplied by the number of weeks you expect to receive it in your projected 2026 annual income when applying for premium tax credits. This matters because a higher projected income may push you above Georgia Pathways' 100% FPL threshold, making you eligible for Georgia Access Marketplace subsidies instead. An accurate 2026 income projection reduces the chance of owing back advance premium tax credits when you file your federal return using Form 1095-A.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial despues de perder un trabajo en Georgia en 2026?
es.answer: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de cobertura en Georgia comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura medica del empleador y dura 60 dias calendario consecutivos. Por ejemplo, si la cobertura termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP es del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Aplique en GeorgiaAccess.gov (no en healthcare.gov, que ya no procesa inscripciones de Georgia 2026) y seleccione su plan antes del dia 60. Los planes tipicamente entran en vigor el primero del mes siguiente a su inscripcion. Georgia Pathways to Coverage y PeachCare for Kids no tienen fecha limite y estan disponibles todo el ano si los ingresos califican.

es.question: Tiene Georgia expansion de Medicaid? Puedo obtener Medicaid despues de perder mi trabajo en Georgia?
es.answer: Georgia no ha adoptado la expansion completa de Medicaid del ACA a partir de 2026. La unica opcion de Medicaid para adultos no discapacitados de 19 a 64 anos que no estan embarazados es Georgia Pathways to Coverage, disponible para aquellos con ingresos proyectados bajo el 100% FPL ($15,960 al ano para una persona en 2026) que documentan 80 horas calificadas al mes de trabajo, entrenamiento laboral, educacion, cuidado de un nino menor de 6 anos, u otras actividades aprobadas. Aplique en gateway.ga.gov o llame al 1-877-423-4746. La mayoria de trabajadores georgianos despedidos con ingresos entre 100% y 400% FPL deben usar el SEP del Mercado Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov para cobertura subsidiada.

es.question: Donde me inscribo en un plan de salud despues de perder mi trabajo en Georgia en 2026?
es.answer: Los residentes de Georgia deben solicitar a traves de Georgia Access en GeorgiaAccess.gov, no en healthcare.gov. Georgia hizo la transicion a su propio Mercado basado en el estado a partir del ano del plan 2025. Inicie sesion en GeorgiaAccess.gov, informe su evento calificador de vida (perdida de cobertura del trabajo), cargue su carta de terminacion o certificado HIPAA, y compare los planes Silver, Gold y Bronze disponibles para su codigo postal de Georgia. Para ayuda gratuita, llame al centro de contacto de Georgia Access al 888-687-1503 o encuentre un agente de seguros o navegador certificado por Georgia en GeorgiaAccess.gov.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida del trabajo para la solicitud SEP de Georgia Access?
es.answer: GeorgiaAccess.gov acepta su carta de terminacion del empleador de Georgia, un aviso de eleccion COBRA, o un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA como documentacion del evento calificador de vida. El documento debe mostrar la fecha exacta en que termina su cobertura del empleador. Cargue el documento cuando comience su solicitud SEP en GeorgiaAccess.gov. Si aun no tiene el documento, puede comenzar la solicitud y cargarlo despues, pero su ventana SEP de 60 dias sigue corriendo. Contacte inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su antiguo empleador en Georgia para solicitar la carta de terminacion y el certificado HIPAA por escrito.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder un trabajo en Georgia en 2026?
es.answer: COBRA raramente es la mejor opcion financiera para los trabajadores georgianos despedidos. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, lo que significa que paga tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas una tarifa del 2%. Para un empleado individual en Georgia, eso tipicamente alcanza $500 a $900 al mes en 2026. Para una familia, COBRA a menudo llega a $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. Los planes Silver del Mercado Georgia Access con creditos fiscales de prima tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados en GeorgiaAccess.gov. COBRA tiene sentido principalmente si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista que no esta en ninguna red de Georgia Access, o si tiene un deducible de 2026 sustancialmente cumplido que necesita preservar hasta fin de ano.

es.question: Que es PeachCare for Kids en Georgia, y califica mi hijo despues de que pierdo mi trabajo?
es.answer: PeachCare for Kids es el programa CHIP de Georgia que cubre a ninos menores de 19 en familias con ingresos hasta el 247% FPL, aproximadamente $81,510 al ano para una familia de cuatro en 2026. Las primas mensuales van de $0 a $35. La inscripcion en PeachCare es todo el ano sin fecha limite de 60 dias. Incluso si sus propios ingresos lo descalifican de Georgia Pathways to Coverage, sus hijos pueden calificar para PeachCare a poco o ningun costo. Aplique en gateway.ga.gov o georgiaaccess.gov, o llame al 1-877-423-4746. Un padre puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado Georgia Access mientras inscribe a sus hijos en PeachCare simultaneamente para minimizar el costo total del seguro familiar.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 60 dias despues de perder el trabajo en Georgia?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura significa que tipicamente no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado Georgia Access subsidiado hasta el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta 2027, que corre del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero de 2027, creando una posible brecha de cobertura. Georgia Pathways to Coverage y PeachCare for Kids permanecen abiertos todo el ano independientemente de la ventana SEP. Si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida durante la brecha (mudarse dentro de Georgia a un nuevo condado, casarse, tener un bebe), ese evento reinicia un nuevo SEP de 60 dias en GeorgiaAccess.gov. Los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) en Georgia ofrecen atencion primaria a escala deslizante para los georgianos sin seguro durante cualquier brecha de cobertura.

es.question: Cuenta el ingreso por desempleo para la elegibilidad de subsidio de Georgia Access en 2026?
es.answer: Si. La compensacion por desempleo del Departamento de Trabajo de Georgia cuenta como ingreso para los calculos del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) del ACA en GeorgiaAccess.gov. Incluya su beneficio semanal de desempleo multiplicado por el numero de semanas que espera recibirlo en su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026 al solicitar creditos fiscales de prima. Una proyeccion precisa de ingresos de 2026 reduce la posibilidad de deber creditos fiscales de prima anticipados de vuelta cuando presente su declaracion federal usando el Formulario 1095-A.

note.en: Official Georgia state Marketplace SEP rules for loss of job-based coverage and qualifying life events. Georgia residents use GeorgiaAccess.gov, not healthcare.gov, for 2026 ACA enrollment.
note.es: Reglas oficiales del SEP del Mercado estatal de Georgia para perdida de cobertura del trabajo y eventos calificadores de vida. Los residentes de Georgia usan GeorgiaAccess.gov, no healthcare.gov, para la inscripcion ACA 2026.

note.en: Official eligibility rules for Georgia's limited Medicaid expansion program for adults ages 19 to 64 with income under 100% FPL and 80-hour monthly activity requirement.
note.es: Reglas oficiales de elegibilidad para el programa limitado de expansion de Medicaid de Georgia para adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos bajo el 100% FPL y requisito de actividad mensual de 80 horas.

note.en: Official Georgia CHIP program eligibility criteria, income limits to 247% FPL, and enrollment process for children under 19.
note.es: Criterios oficiales de elegibilidad del programa CHIP de Georgia, limites de ingresos hasta el 247% FPL, y proceso de inscripcion para ninos menores de 19.

sources.name: HealthCare.gov: Loss of coverage qualifying event and SEP rules

note.es: Reglas federales del SEP para perdida de cobertura del trabajo bajo el ACA, incluyendo la ventana de inscripcion de 60 dias y los requisitos de documentacion.

sources.name: IRS: COBRA Continuation Coverage Frequently Asked Questions

note.en: COBRA eligibility, 60-day election window, 102% premium rule, and 18-month duration for job-loss qualifying events.
note.es: Elegibilidad COBRA, ventana de eleccion de 60 dias, regla de prima del 102%, y duracion de 18 meses para eventos calificadores de perdida del trabajo.

note.es: Rastreador KFF del estado de expansion de Medicaid por estado, documentando a Georgia como un estado sin expansion y la brecha de cobertura que afecta a aproximadamente 359,000 georgianos.
